descriptionEn:
Question on § “Determination of the composition of an apple” (Kimyo, grade 7).

Wording: Which of the following corresponds to the material in the paragraph “Determination of the composition of an apple”?

Correct answer: Type of atoms with the same nuclear charge (number of protons).

Element = atoms with the same number of protons Z.

Paragraph material (support for answer):

1. Almost all researchers admit that apples are one of the healthiest fruits.

2. Although the apple does not hold the record for nutritional value, it is considered the most delicious and healthy fruit on earth.

3. Rejuvenates the body and strengthens the immune system.

4. Iron contained in apples is very useful in treating anemia.

Remember: the answer must match the wording of the textbook. After choosing an option, check yourself again using the text §.
descriptionUz:
§ “Olmaning tarkibini aniqlash” bo‘yicha savol (Kimyo, 7-sinf).

So'z: Quyidagilardan qaysi biri "Olma tarkibini aniqlash" bandidagi materialga mos keladi?

To'g'ri javob: Yadro zaryadi bir xil bo'lgan atomlar turi (protonlar soni).

Element = Z protonlari soni bir xil bo'lgan atomlar.

Paragraf materiali (javobni qo'llab-quvvatlash):

1. Deyarli barcha tadqiqotchilar olma eng foydali mevalardan biri ekanligini tan olishadi.

2. Olma ozuqaviy qiymati bo‘yicha rekord o‘rnatmasa-da, u yer yuzidagi eng mazali va sog‘lom meva hisoblanadi.

3. Organizmni yoshartiradi va immunitetni mustahkamlaydi.

4. Olma tarkibidagi temir kamqonlikni davolashda juda foydali.

Esingizda bo'lsin: javob darslik matniga mos kelishi kerak. Variantni tanlagandan so'ng, § matni yordamida o'zingizni yana tekshiring.
explanationEn: Element = atoms with the same number of protons Z.
explanationUz: Element = Z protonlari soni bir xil bo'lgan atomlar.
